description: Defines logging classes for procedures and UE procedures within the ocudu::odu namespace, including methods for logging procedure start, progress, completion, failure, and warnings.

classes.name: du_procedure_logger
classes.description: Provides logging functionalities for general procedures, including start, progress, completion, and failure logs.

classes.name: ue_procedure_logger
classes.description: Provides logging functionalities for UE-specific procedures, including start, progress, completion, failure, and warning logs, with UE index and RNTI context.

methods.name: log_proc_started
methods.description: Logs the start of a procedure.

methods.name: log_progress
methods.description: Logs progress messages with formatted arguments.

methods.name: log_proc_completed
methods.description: Logs the successful completion of a procedure.

methods.name: log_proc_failure
methods.description: Logs a failure message with a reason.

methods.name: log_proc_warning
methods.description: Logs a warning message related to UE procedures.

methods.name: log_impl
methods.description: Internal method to output log messages with a specific log channel.
